directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools, sub-lane checks: the rendered-video checker's helper scripts
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; settings are rows in the person's lists, read through the door.

preserve: check, batch, review-pack, variety, map-add and declare keep their arguments, report and last line
MODULES from pins.CHECK_SECTIONS stays the one list of checks
allowed_deltas: pins: each check's pin against the person's reviewed pins (what the film's repin.py wrote into its config)
inspect <what> and export-spans hand their arguments to inspect_<what>.py and spans.py
request: one JSON request with the person's list:settings row, read by tools/settings request_settings, runs any command
banned_substitutions: a second settings reader beside tools/settings
a default limits file shipped with the tool
